work.heading: Projects:
work.subheading: Projects that showcase my experience in machine learning, analytics, automation, and software development from research prototypes to production-ready tools.

projects.name: Job Notifier
projects.subtitle: n8n Workflow Automation
projects.description: An end-to-end job intelligence platform that automatically collects, processes, and delivers curated job opportunities through an automated data pipeline.
bullets: Built an automated ETL pipeline using n8n that collects job postings from multiple sources, cleans and normalizes data, and synchronizes records into Supabase with duplicate detection.
Designed an event-driven notification workflow that tracks delivery status, ensuring each opportunity is sent exactly once through Telegram.
Developed a daily job digest with filtering, seniority grouping, and direct application links to improve job discovery.

projects.name: Classification of Imbalance Datasets
projects.subtitle: Resampler Benchmarking
projects.description: A research project investigating how different resampling strategies affect machine learning performance on imbalanced datasets.
bullets: Synthesized imbalance datasets of varying complexities to experiment with SMOTE, Borderline-SMOTE, and NB-Basic resampling methods.
Discovered the dependency of overlap measurement effectiveness on data shape and encountered technical limits when attempting to reach 100% overlap.
All planned combinations of data shapes and imbalance ratios were successfully generated and used to train and validate a Random Forest classification model.

projects.name: ANPR System
projects.subtitle: YOLOv8
projects.description: A computer vision application that detects vehicles, recognizes license plates, and extracts plate numbers using deep learning and OCR.
bullets: Developed an end-to-end automatic license plate recognition system using YOLOv8 and EasyOCR.
Improved detection accuracy through image enhancement and preprocessing techniques.
Built a desktop application for image upload, visualization, and automated result export.

projects.name: Churn Analysis
projects.subtitle: Rapid Miner
projects.description: A customer analytics project that predicts churn risk to support customer retention strategies.
bullets: Developed a churn prediction workflow in RapidMiner to classify customer retention risk using banking and demographic data.
Handled class imbalance using MetaCost and cost-sensitive learning techniques, with a strong focus on improving prediction precision for business decision support.
Achieved precision scores of 84.5% for churn prediction and 85.8% for non-churn prediction through evaluation and model optimization workflows.

projects.name: Salary Classification
projects.subtitle: ANN Model
projects.description: A machine learning application that predicts income categories using demographic data and evaluates model performance through statistical metrics.
bullets: Built and evaluated ANN-based classification models using Python and Scikit-learn.
Applied preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, and feature engineering to improve model performance.
Compared model performance using F1-score, confusion matrices, and classification metrics.

items.description: Developing machine learning and analytics solutions for large-scale manufacturing data, transforming complex engineering information into actionable insights that support process optimization and operational decision-making.
